name: aerolvm
description: Run commands, edit files and expose ports in AerolVM sandboxes. Registers the aerolvm MCP server and teaches the aerolvm CLI. Needs the aerolvm binary on PATH.

api_url.title: sandboxd URL
api_url.description: Where your sandboxd answers, e.g. https://sandbox.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:21212

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Your AerolVM API token (the PAT token install.sh printed, or one your operator issued)
